title: Kaidoro
description: Founder & Software Engineer. An AI-powered planning platform that turns learning and career goals into phased, adaptive roadmaps, with one canonical structure viewable three ways: an Excel checklist, an interactive node graph, and a self-paced course. Full-stack build: React/TypeScript frontend, Python/FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, authentication and Gemini API integration. Live at kaidoro.app in private testing (access-code gated), opening to the public once the system is scaled.

title: RoomQuest
description: Selected as 1 of 52 participants from 1,000 applicants for a Google-run AI hackathon. Acted as project manager for a 5-person team at the Google Student AI Hackathon (London), defining product scope, system architecture and tech stack under a 3-hour build constraint. Directed AI-assisted development through an AI Studio → Antigravity → Google Cloud workflow to ship a working demo that generates room-aware puzzle clues via Gemini multimodal vision in under 5 seconds, and built and presented the accompanying business case ($14.8B TAM, $3.53B SAM) and go-to-market strategy alongside it.

title: Student Performance Predictor
description: End-to-end machine learning regression pipeline predicting student exam scores from 13 numerical and categorical features. Compared and tuned four regression models (Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) using MAE, RMSE, R² and 5-fold cross-validation to evaluate generalisation. Selected Linear Regression as the final model, achieving R² = 0.825 and MAE = 0.415 on the held-out test set, then used residual and feature analysis to identify model limitations and unexplained high-score predictions: the ensemble methods never earned back the complexity they added.

title: FocusFlow API
description: RESTful productivity analytics API built with FastAPI, using JWT authentication, SQLAlchemy ORM and PostgreSQL. Relational data models for tasks, categories and productivity sessions with secure user-scoped access. Analytics endpoints built on SQL aggregation queries to calculate productivity trends, category breakdowns and study streaks.

title: Coursework Deadline Optimiser
description: Full-stack coursework management application built and deployed with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and JWT authentication, on a layered Controller–Service–Repository architecture. Scheduling algorithm prioritises study time based on deadline urgency, task difficulty and course weighting. CI/CD deployment via GitHub and Render.

title: Loughborough University Route Finder
description: A* pathfinding with Euclidean heuristic for optimised campus routing with obstacle avoidance and multi-waypoint support. Graph visualisation using NetworkX and Matplotlib with coordinate-mapped nodes and edge weights.

title: Notion PDF Exporter
description: Native macOS app that batch-converts an entire exported Notion workspace to PDFs, preserving folder structure, formatting, callouts and tables. Runs 100% locally: no subscription, no account, no data leaving the machine.

title: AI Study Assistant
description: Flutter mobile app that turns uploaded lecture-note PDFs into structured study material: summaries, key topics, flashcards and quiz questions, via a FastAPI backend and the Gemini API, with Firebase auth and a PostgreSQL-backed analysis history.

title: LEDController
description: Native macOS menu-bar app for Bluetooth LE LED strip control, with real-time screen-sync lighting powered by ScreenCaptureKit, K-means dominant-colour extraction and Apple Vision scene classification.

title: VolumeController
description: Menu-bar utility that controls multiple macOS audio output devices independently via CoreAudio's HAL directly: no virtual driver or kernel extension required, unlike alternatives such as BackgroundMusic.
